headline: Capri Global Capital submits interest payment certificate for BSE-listed securities
summary: Capri Global Capital Limited has formally informed the stock exchanges regarding the issuance of its certificate for the payment of interest on BSE-listed instruments. Such filings are standard regulatory compliance procedures undertaken by non-banking financial companies to confirm timely debt servicing. Retail investors holding the company's bonds or shares can note the regular debt obligation fulfillment.
why_it_matters: Confirms routine debt servicing by the NBFC.

headline: Capri Global Capital sets record date for CP redemption
hook: Record date set for CP redemption
summary: Capri Global Capital Limited announced the record date for the redemption of its commercial paper (CP) listed on BSE. The CP redemption will return principal and accrued interest to holders on the specified date. Investors holding the CP should note the record date to ensure they receive the payment. This is a routine corporate event with no broader market impact.
why_it_matters: CP holders receive payment on record date

headline: Capri Global Capital redeems commercial paper worth ₹2,500 lakh
summary: Capri Global Capital has completed the redemption of commercial paper valued at ₹2,500 lakh. Commercial papers are short-term unsecured debt instruments issued by corporations to finance short-term liabilities. The full repayment reflects debt servicing capability on maturity dates. For Indian retail investors, debt redemption updates indicate routine liquidity management by non-banking financial companies.
why_it_matters: Routine debt repayment shows ongoing liquidity management.

headline: Capri Global Capital redeems its BSE-listed commercial paper
summary: Capri Global Capital Limited has informed stock exchanges about the redemption of its commercial paper listed on the BSE. headline: Capri Global Capital intimates redemption of listed Commercial Paper

headline: Capri Global Capital issues $30 million in bonds
hook: Capri Global raises $30 million via bonds
summary: Capri Global Capital has announced the issuance of bonds worth $30 million. This move is part of the company's strategy to raise capital for its operations. The issuance provides the firm with additional liquidity to support its lending activities. Retail investors should note that this debt issuance impacts the company's balance sheet and interest obligations.
why_it_matters: Increased debt levels may impact future profitability and interest coverage ratios.

headline: Capri Global Capital finalizes bond terms and registrar
hook: New bond terms and RTA appointed
summary: Capri Global Capital has announced the outcome of its committee meeting held on October 19, 2026. The company finalized the terms and conditions for issuing bonds. It also appointed a Registrar and Transfer Agent (RTA) for the issuance. For retail investors, this routine capital-raising update has no immediate impact on stock price or earnings.
why_it_matters: Routine corporate debt update with no immediate portfolio impact

headline: Capri Global Capital announces record dates for FY 2027 NCD interest payments
hook: Record dates set for FY 2027 NCD payouts
summary: Capri Global Capital Limited has officially informed the stock exchanges regarding the schedule of record dates for interest payments on its BSE-listed Non-Convertible Debentures (NCDs) for the financial year 2027. This routine corporate filing outlines the timeline for fixed-income holders to determine eligibility for upcoming interest distributions. Retail investors holding these specific NCDs can verify these dates to track their scheduled income flows. No broader market impact is expected from this administrative disclosure.
why_it_matters: NCD holders track exact interest payment eligibility dates.

headline: Capri Global Capital dispatches postal ballot notice for shareholder approval
hook: Postal ballot notice issued for shareholders
summary: Capri Global Capital has issued a notice of postal ballot to its shareholders in compliance with SEBI listing regulations. The company is seeking shareholder approval on specific corporate resolutions through remote e-voting. Retail investors holding shares in the company will need to review the proposals and participate in the e-voting process. This is a standard corporate governance procedure required for listed entities.
whats_next: Remote e-voting deadline to be announced

headline: Capri Global Capital submits September 2026 ALM reporting to the exchange
hook: Routine regulatory submission from Capri Global
summary: Capri Global Capital Limited has formally submitted its Asset Liability Management (ALM) reporting for September 2026 to the stock exchanges. This is a routine compliance filing required for non-banking financial companies (NBFCs) to disclose their liquidity and maturity profiles. Retail investors generally do not need to take immediate action on standard ALM filings unless significant asset-liability mismatches are explicitly highlighted.
why_it_matters: Standard liquidity disclosure with no immediate impact on stock price.

headline: Capri Global Capital announces board meeting outcome
hook: Routine corporate update from Capri Global
summary: Capri Global Capital Limited has formally informed the stock exchange regarding the outcome of its board meeting held on October 14, 2026. Such routine disclosures keep investors updated on corporate governance and procedural approvals. Indian retail shareholders should track subsequent detailed announcements for any material impact on business operations.
why_it_matters: Routine filing with no immediate impact on share price

summary: Capri Global Capital has submitted a compliance certificate confirming the payment of interest on its non-convertible debentures (NCDs) listed on the BSE. headline: Capri Global Capital redeems BSE-listed commercial paper
hook: Routine debt settlement at Capri Global
summary: Capri Global Capital Limited has notified the stock exchanges about the redemption of its BSE-listed commercial paper pursuant to Regulation 57 of SEBI LODR Regulations. Retail investors holding the company's equity or debt instruments can note the fulfillment of short-term debt obligations, though routine debt execution typically has negligible immediate impact on stock prices.

headline: Capri Global Capital allots 16,000 non-convertible securities
hook: Small debt allotment from Capri Global

Non-convertible securities are debt instruments that do not convert into equity shares. This routine capital-raising action has a negligible immediate impact on retail shareholders. It represents standard corporate debt management by the non-banking financial company.
why_it_matters: Routine debt allotment with no immediate impact on retail investors.

headline: Capri Global Capital announces Navratri gold loan offer
hook: Capri Gold Loan waives half of processing fees
summary: Capri Global Capital Limited has introduced a Navratri special offer for its gold loan customers. The company is providing a 50% waiver on processing fees for new loans. This promotional campaign is timed to coincide with the festive season to attract borrowers. The announcement was formally communicated to the NSE on October 13, 2026.
why_it_matters: Potential increase in gold loan disbursements during the festive season.
winners_losers: Borrowers gain / Capri Global margins slightly pressured
